reviews.comment: I've gone to this floating sauna a couple of times and found it unique, relaxing, clean and a breath of fresh air. Recently, I went for a morning session around 11. After some time I went up on the roof deck to catch some sun and they moved closer to the sauna and continued to talk and look my way. This started making me uncomfortable. They didn't wave or explain why they were there. As a single woman who has traveled worldwide, I am hyper aware of my surroundings. I went back into the sauna and a few minutes back in the sauna they moved even closer and moved the sauna up and down and I could hear them just outside talking. I tried to shrug it off but l ended up leaving because I didn't feel safe nor could I relax. Unfortunately, I do not think I will be back to visit. Certainly not alone.

Every piece of feedback like yours shapes how we keep building this experience, and I'd love the chance to host you back once the new space is in place.

reviews.comment:
The sauna itself is wonderful and the overall experience was a lot of fun. Since we booked the “social sauna,” I expected some chatting and laughter, which is totally part of the atmosphere. Unfortunately, during our visit there was a particularly rowdy group with very loud voices who ended up taking up most of the space, so it was difficult to find a place to sit comfortably. At one point they even moved our towels, which was a bit frustrating.

That said, the sauna itself is fantastic and the setting makes for a really unique experience. I do think it would help if there were a few reminders or signs encouraging guests to keep voices at a respectful level and to be mindful that many people come for a peaceful experience. I understand they can’t control how people will act but a few signs would be awesome to remind folks.

Despite that, we still had a good time. Jumping into the river is especially fun and definitely something you should try if you visit. We’d likely come back and hope for a quieter group next time. Ideally without a sauna debate about politics and gas prices.

reviewReply.comment:
Carlie, 

Thank you for taking the time to leave a thoughtful review and for sharing your experience. We are really glad to hear you enjoyed the sauna itself and the river plunge. That hot cold rhythm on the dock is exactly what makes the place special.

Our Social Sauna sessions are designed as a shared experience where different groups may book the same time and enjoy the space together. For many guests that community energy is part of the fun, though we understand it can occasionally mean the dynamic of a particular group shapes the atmosphere more than expected.

Because the sauna is a self guided, unstaffed experience, the tone of each session relies a bit on the shared awareness and etiquette of everyone in the space. We do encourage guests to keep voices at a respectful level, be mindful of seating, and leave others belongings where they are. Your note about towels being moved is a good reminder of how important that awareness is.

We are currently working on improving how we set expectations ahead of time by updating our website and confirmation emails to better explain what a Social Sauna experience entails and how guests can help maintain a comfortable environment for everyone.

We have also considered adding more signage, though we try to keep the space visually calm and uncluttered so the setting still feels natural and restorative. That said, feedback like yours helps us think carefully about where a gentle reminder might be helpful.

Looking ahead, we are also planning additional smaller sauna spaces which will offer a more intimate option for guests seeking a quieter or more private experience.

For anyone hoping for a more peaceful session in the meantime, we often recommend early morning bookings, especially the 7am sessions, visiting Monday through Thursday, or booking a private sauna for a fully controlled experience.

We really appreciate you taking the time to share such balanced feedback, and we hope to welcome you back again. Hopefully with fewer debates about politics and gas prices next time.

reviews.comment: A truly unique Portland Gem awaits! Everything about this experience was stellar. Easy to book, great info on the website, helpful signage to locate free parking and to guide you down the docks, indoor restroom and shower with heated floors, a covered outdoor lounge area with heat lamp and more all on the water - even before stepping into the sauna itself we knew this was our type of adventure! The sauna itself it lovely - charred wood accents the door as you enter the warm welcoming embrace of Ebb and Ember. There’s a small vestibule to hang your drying off towel and leave your shoes - there’s even some instructions on the wall of how to enjoy your time - then enter through the next door to meet the heat and cedar scented wonder of the sauna! Huge windows welcome panoramic views of the river - keep your eyes peeled for wildlife! We saw bald eagles fishing in the water nearby - absolutely stunning sight! After you’ve had enough heat, there’s an outdoor shower you can cool off under or if you’re brave enough you can jump off the floating sauna into river - there’s even a way to jump from the roof! I just lowered myself in slowly and it was fantastic. After, we enjoyed the view from the rooftop while chatting with some other guests - a perfect day! Thank you, Ebb and Ember - we can’t wait to come back!

reviews.comment:
I had an incredible experience at Elevated Tides Floating Sauna last night! The sauna temperature was absolutely perfect; hot enough to really get a great sweat going. The interior is amazing and spacious. Stepping right outside onto the deck and plunging into the Columbia River afterward was the ultimate cold plunge reset.

The sauna itself is beautifully designed, with a rooftop deck that offers a stunning view of the river and the city. The highlight for me was catching breathtaking views of Mount Hood in the distance—it made the whole evening feel magical.

Located at the Elevated Tides Marina in Northeast Portland, this floating sauna is a hidden gem. The combination of heat, cold plunge, and unbeatable scenery makes it a truly unique experience. I’ll definitely be coming back again and again!
